# GitHub Actions the workflows may use (checked by scripts/check-actions.sh, spec release-ci 7.2).
#
# Format: one action per line, `owner/repo <SPDX license expression>`. `uses: owner/repo/path@sha`
# maps to `owner/repo`. `A OR B` is allowed when one operand is, `A AND B` when every operand is.
# Only licenses from the `allow` list of deny.toml count, so no Swatinem/rust-cache (LGPL-3.0).
# `#` starts a comment; blank lines are ignored.
#
# A new action needs its license checked here first; every `uses:` line is then pinned to a
# 40-character commit SHA with a `# vX.Y.Z` comment.
actions/checkout MIT
actions/cache MIT
actions/setup-node MIT
actions/upload-artifact MIT
actions/download-artifact MIT
pnpm/action-setup MIT
astral-sh/setup-uv MIT OR Apache-2.0
taiki-e/install-action Apache-2.0 OR MIT
msys2/setup-msys2 MIT
samypr100/setup-dev-drive MIT
